name: Men's Class B blue short-sleeve shirt and trousers (nametag position only)
size_basis: Silhouette traced from images/base/blues_class_b_male.webp (581x719 px) at 0.0474 in/px. Same canvas and scale assumption as the Class A coat. No real garment was measured. Then the whole sheet is scaled by 1.2171 (LIVE-ART2 item 1; 0.0474 in/px becomes 0.0577): the men's pocket measures 4.31 in wide on the traced image, and a USAF-style men's size-M short-sleeve shirt pocket is about 5.25 in wide x 6 in tall (ESTIMATE: AF shirt pattern dimension supplied with the task, no CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903 dimension; the CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.9 nametag (3 3/8 in) read as a ruler gives a smaller 4.56 in, the figure is schematic), so K = 5.25 / 4.313. The pocket is drawn 5.25 x 6.0 in, flap 2.02 in deep. Nameplate, epaulet strap width, buttons and strokes stay true size.
landmarks_note: rects are {x,y,w,h}; polygons are [[x,y]...]; all in user units (0.01 in), origin top-left of the artwork box; sleeve_flat_view {left:{x,y},right:{x,y}} is where the top_center of the flat sleeve assets <id>-sleeve-flat-left / -right sits beside the figure (outboard of each arm, its top at the shoulder seam height, 1 in clear of the sleeve outline; it lies outside this artwork box)

measured.figure: CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.8 (men's long-sleeve figure) at this sheet's scale (x 0.03664, y 0.03299 in/px, make-long-outlines.js)
measured.photo: images/base/lt_col_blues_class_b_male.webp edge-on strip 117 px = 5.1 in at the 5.25 in pocket scale, slope 21 deg

epaulet_strap.note: the strap lies along the shoulder line N-SP of the finished silhouette (dimensions.finishing), its outer end is the armhole seam, 1.0 in wide as commit 72a36ce9; the button 1/2 in from the tip is the brief's value, no figure shows it under the sleeve; the sheet's whole shoulder line is 5.79 in

tie.source: CAPR 39-1 Fig 4.8: knot 2.12 in wide 1.75 in below its apex, neck 1.4 in, blade 1.44 in widening to 3.0 in at the belt (row widths of the figure at this sheet's scale); the tip at 80 % of the buckle height

finishing.note: shoulder line straightened between the neck vertex and the shoulder point, armhole seam from the shoulder point to the armpit apex, hem hook / gap bulge removed (finishShoulderArmpit)

scale.note: pocket 5.25 x 6 in = USAF-style men's size-M short-sleeve shirt (estimate); the whole sheet scaled so the traced pocket width equals it

sleeve_widening.note: outward warp of the sleeve between the armhole seam and the outer edge (seam, body, shoulder and straps unmoved) so the true-size 3 1/2 in chevron lies between the outline and the armhole seam; an estimate, the regulation gives no sleeve width
sleeve_widening.chevron_fit_note: clearance in inches from every row of the 3 1/2 in chevron, placed as the engine does (visual centre on chevron_halfway, turned along shoulder_seam to sleeve_bottom), to the outer edge and to the armhole seam; positive = on the sleeve. The women's 4 in option (4.1.12.2.3.3, the 3 1/2 in art scaled to 4.00 x 6.54 in) is listed under 4 and still overhangs, clipped to the silhouette by the engine

documented: light blue short-sleeve shirt, two pleated pockets, epaulets (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1)
nameplate centred on, resting on (not over) the top edge of the wearer's right pocket (4.1.11.1.1.2.1)
ribbons centred on, resting on the top edge of the wearer's left pocket (4.1.11.1.1.2.2)
cadet officers: miniature grade on blue epaulet sleeves; cadet NCOs/airmen: metal chevrons on both sides of the collar, 1 in from and parallel to the front of the collar (4.1.11.1.1.1.4)
blue belt with plain silver tip and buckle, tip toward the wearer's left (4.1.11.1.1.5)
assumed: px-to-inch scale (0.0474 in/px x K, K from the 5.25 in pocket width, an estimate)
nameplate size (3.375 x 0.75 in = Vanguard CAP0599M cadet name plate (blue plastic, 3 3/8 x 3/4 in); no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903; no dimension in CAPR 39-1 or DAFI 36-2903)
epaulet strap drawn on the sheet from the shoulder line: 1.0 in wide, 0.5 in point, button 1/2 in from the tip (the brief's value), topstitch 0.1 in (dimensions.epaulet_strap)
collar leaf, pocket and seam geometry read off the base image
shirt, trouser/skirt and line colours sampled from the base image
sleeve widening: the sleeve is drawn wider than the traced hanging view (CFG.widen, dimensions.sleeve_widening)
belt strap colour #14347f (and its #7d95d6 stitching) is a choice, not sampled: the base image paints the belt the same navy as the trousers; regulation says only blue belt (4.1.11.1.1.5, 4.1.12.7)
trousers cut off at the base image's crop line
